decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a diverse set of speakers ranging from ultra-portable budget options like the Altec Lansing Mini H2O to premium home setups like the Edifier S350DB and Sonos sets. While the Bose SoundLink Color II is a well-known standard for portable audio, multiple reviews across the high-end options mentioned longevity issues or frustrating software/connectivity barriers (especially with Sonos and Ortizan). Additionally, a significant portion of the search results were protective cases and accessories rather than actual speakers, which limited the variety of high-quality hardware available in this session. Given the reliability concerns for the higher-priced units, I have decided not to make a purchase today.
